sources.title: bart-large-mnli: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview bart-large-mnli is a zero-shot text classification model built by facebook by fine-tuning the BART-large sequence-to-sequence architecture on the MultiNLI dataset. The model converts text classification into natural language inference by treating the input sequence as an NLI premise and constructing hypotheses from candidate labels, then deriving class probabilities from entailment ...
